model: Land Cruiser Rival/Eagle GX Carbon Wheels
description: Designed to take you far, get you there fast and keep you comfortable for the ride, the Land Cruiser is a real all-round fast gravel bikepacking ready rig. Pair it with a set of 700c wheels on 35-50mm rubber for road and gravel adventures or switch to a pair of 650B hoops with 2.35" boots if you'll be riding some rough stuff. Available in three standard build options all utilising SRAM AXS shifting for a business up front, party in the back (10-52tooth) mullet drivetrain. Starting with the Rival/Eagle GX combo going up to the Force/Eagle XX1 dream machine. Variations on the standard builds (outlined below) can be coordinated via consultation. Send us an email to discuss. Please note that all builds have a lead time of at least 12 weeks. Build details coming shortly.......
